x: In the junior race we saw a new Pirie, for the manner in which North slammed the field in such conditions, was a revelation. It seems almost a travesty of justice that he was not awarded his international vest.

What is it about men like Firth, Driver, Pirie and company which enables them always to strike the front within half a mile or so? Pat Newell, running in his first cross country race this season, clung tenaciously to a good start and was always placed around the forty mark.

In no way deterred by the reputations enjoyed by his opponents, Charlie Dabbs clung to the redoubtable Pirie and title-holder Ernie Earl sufficiently well to gain a notable 3rd place in the 3 miles, clocking 14:21.8---a personal best.
Pirie was an easy winner for S.L.H. smashing previous course records set by Hyman and Foord by nearly a minute. Ken Miller was a good third, with Thresher 7th, Walker 8th and Shippen 10th.
For besides the oppresive heat he also had to contend with Messrs. Pirie, Hyman, Eldon & Co. Pat ran, relatively, as well as anybody in the field to record 14:14, but was outside the first six.
Perhaps the County needs a Pirie or Hewson to bring back the crowds. If so, there is plenty of potential amongst the County's Youth, and Belgrave have their fair share of it.

Gordon Pirie crosses the line in the Surrey Road Relay Championship of 9th September 1961, taking South London Harriers to victory. Gordon's time was a full two minutes faster than any one else on that day.
